document.title: Globalisation and local traditions
document.question:
Many people believe that international brands, films and social media are making countries more and more alike. Some even argue that local traditions and languages will soon disappear.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
